#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

    long long rem = 1LL << 32;
    long long res_a = 1LL << 32;
    long long res_b = 1LL << 32;

    long long x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    for (long long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        long long a = max(x * b / y - 10, 0LL);
        for (int j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
            long long diff = abs(x * b - (a + j) * y);
            if (rem * b > diff * res_b) {
                rem = diff;
                res_a = a + j;
                res_b = b;
            } else if (rem * b == diff * res_b) {
                if (res_b > b || (res_b == b && res_a > a + j)) {
                    rem = diff;
                    res_a = a + j;
                    res_b = b;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << res_a << "/" << res_b << endl;
}
